lead: Vladimir Putin is best known as a Russian politician, born on 7 October 1952 in V.F. Snegiryov Maternity Hospital No.6.
As of 2026, he is 73 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.

He is associated with work such as A Plea for Caution From Russia, Russia at the Turn of the Millennium and Russia Muscles Up — the Challenges We Must Rise to Face and has held the office of President of Russia.
This profile collects the Vladimir facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Vladimir Putin — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Vladimir Putin was born on 7 October 1952 in V.F. Snegiryov Maternity Hospital No.6, and holds Russian nationality.
Public records name his father, Vladimir Putin and his mother, Maria Putina.
He received his education at Academy of the Federal Security Service of the Russian Federation, Faculty of Law, Saint Petersburg State University, Academy of Foreign Intelligence and School 193.
He is recorded as speaking Russian, German and English.

sections.heading: Vladimir Putin — Career and Professional Work
paras: Vladimir Putin works primarily as a politician, with KGB, First Chief Directorate and Administrative Directorate of the President of the Russian Federation listed among his employers.

Among the credits most often linked to Vladimir are A Plea for Caution From Russia, Russia at the Turn of the Millennium, Russia Muscles Up — the Challenges We Must Rise to Face, Russia: The Ethnicity Issue, Economic Tasks, Democracy and the Quality of Government, Building Justice: A Social Policy for Russia, Being Strong: National Security Guarantees for Russia, Time to Trust Russia: A Common Front Against Terror and We Share German Priorities.
He has held the following offices: President of Russia (2012–present). He is affiliated with Communist Party of the Soviet Union.
He has taken part in Russian military intervention in the Syrian civil war, Second Chechen War, 2015 G20 Antalya summit, 2014 G20 Brisbane summit and 2016 G20 Hangzhou summit.

sections.heading: Vladimir Putin — Family, Marriage and Personal Life

sections.heading: Vladimir Putin — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Vladimir Putin circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.

What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a politician, employment with KGB, First Chief Directorate and Administrative Directorate of the President of the Russian Federation, project fees and royalties from credited work and public office remuneration.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
